headline: Friday's tech bounce faded into the close as a hot jobs report lifted the dollar and December hike odds.
brief: The Nasdaq-100 rose 1.35% to 26,990 on Friday after Thursday's 6.4% plunge, but finished in the lower part of its range as a strong 165,000 payrolls print pushed the 10-yr to 4.86%, the dollar up about 0.8% and December hike odds near 77%. Tonight's Asia session opens with China's October CPI and PPI, with Japanese and Korean chip names in focus after heavy losses last week. The key risk is that the rebound fails ahead of Tuesday's US CPI, with VIX still elevated near 25.6.
